title: Stability and compatibility of resorcin[4]arene hexamer cages with amphiphilic random copolymers in organic solvents
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23662-23672
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01475E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marah Alqaisi, Wolfgang H. Binder
Structural integrity of resorcin[4]arene-based hexamer cages with different side chains (–C4H9, butyl or –C11H23, undecyl) is achieved with water-soluble copolymers in different solvents at molar ratios of up to 1 : 6 (cage : copolymer).
